name: Always-in SMA 30/150 long-short crossover
author: ForexMT4Systems guide
instruments: liquid futures in the source test
entry_long: Hold long while SMA(30) > SMA(150); enter/reverse long on bullish cross.
entry_short: Hold short while SMA(30) < SMA(150); enter/reverse short on bearish cross.
exit: Reverse at the next opposite crossover.
filters: Always invested, one directional position at a time.
claimed_performance: The guide reports an in-sample score for this configuration; not treated as transferable performance.
implementation_notes: Source describes an always-in rule and next-cross reversal. Confirm its futures universe and execution convention before implementation.
